name: dokuwiki
description: Search, read and edit a DokuWiki instance through the DokuWiki MCP plugin over Streamable HTTP. Endpoint and access token are entered when the plugin is enabled — no files to edit.

wiki_url.title: Wiki MCP endpoint
wiki_url.description: Full URL of the MCP endpoint on your wiki — your wiki address plus /lib/plugins/mcp/mcp.php, for example https://wiki.example.com/lib/plugins/mcp/mcp.php

api_token.title: DokuWiki API token
api_token.description: Your personal token from User Profile → Authentication Token. It carries your own wiki permissions, so Claude never sees more than you can.
